title: Moses is allowed to see the Promised Land from Nebo
description: The Lord commands Moses to go up the Abarim mountains, to Mount Nebo in the land of Moab opposite Jericho, to look out over the land of Canaan that the Israelites will receive as their possession. There Moses is to die and be gathered to his people, just as his brother Aaron died on Mount Hor. The reason is that Moses and Aaron were unfaithful to the Lord at the waters of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Sin and did not uphold His holiness among the Israelites. Moses sees the land before him but will not enter it.
